stem.en: A voter has checked the VVPAT slip. What happens to the slip next?

text.en: It drops into a sealed box
An officer reads it out to the room
It is posted to the voter's address

explanation.en: The slip stays behind a small window for a few seconds, so the voter can check that the vote went to the right candidate. It then drops into a sealed box. No voter carries it away.

hints.en: The voter sees the slip through a small window, and never touches it.
